title: Parsley Health theme
description: A calm clinic light theme: warm ivory page, deep forest headings, buttons and dark bands, sage links and soft buttons, clover hairlines, mint and seafoam bands, a beige wash and a sparing ochre. A light book serif (Newsreader at 300) for headings over a round geometric sans (Outfit), 12px corners and pill buttons. A forest-green dark sibling.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is the whole site in forest and deep sea

--primary is forest (headings use text-primary), --secondary sage (soft buttons), --ring the same sage (focus rings, and sage text: eyebrows, links, names), --glow clover (hairline dots, column titles), --accent mint, --muted seafoam bands, --card the beige wash, --highlight ochre
the nav bar and footer are .dark scopes, so the dark palette doubles as their on-dark palette in light mode
--section-y is the desktop padding (7.5rem); blocks use 0.55 of it on phones
